llm_response.reason: Etana.com displays none of the listed scam website characteristics: no unrealistic offers, urgency tactics, ambiguous privacy policy, or unprofessional contact information. It references legitimate business licensing, offers contact via a LinkedIn corporate profile, uses a secure CRM portal, and has an established web domain since 1996. No evidence was found of technical support, investment, or fake shopping scams. Its services match traditional crypto custody and asset protection for institutions and individuals, not scam operations.
